title: APPROVE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOMITA FOR THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES WATERFRONT RED CAR LOAN
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOMITA FOR THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES WATERFRONT RED CAR LOAN
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Transmittal 3
Summary
: Staff requests approval of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and the City of Lomita (Lomita), for the loan of the Port of Los Angeles Waterfront Red Car (Red Car). The Red Car is an authentic replica of the famous 1908 Electric “Red Car” built in 2003 that served Los Angeles until 1961. Relocating this replica Red Car, along with a second replica and one original, is necessary to allow construction of the 22nd Street Parking Lot Improvement Project. Rather than finding another site to store the Red Cars, loaning the Red Car to a museum allows it to be preserved, appreciated, and used for educational purposes. The proposed MOU is associated with Harbor Department's Strategic Plan Objective 4: Strong Relationships with Stakeholders, Initiative 1, which delivers key LA Waterfront development projects on time and on budget; attracts visitors to the LA Waterfront; and identifies other public investment opportunities. The Harbor Department is proposing to provide Lomita with a replica Red Car and up to 60 feet of rail to display at the Lomita Railroad Museum (Museum), a museum dedicated to California’s railroad history, located at 2137 250th Street, Lomita, CA 90717. The proposed term of the MOU is 20 years, commencing on the Effective Date, with two five-year options to extend. The Harbor Department will be responsible for relocating the Red Car from its current location to the Museum, including all costs and necessary permitting for the transportation of the Red Car to its dedicated location of display at the museum. Transportation costs to the Museum will be funded through the 22nd Street Parking Lot project.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and the City of Lomita; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Memorandum of Understanding for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. ___________.
Waterfront & Commercial Real Estate
summary: The Port would loan one of its Red Car replicas, plus up to 60 feet of rail, to the Lomita Railroad Museum under a 20-year agreement with the City of Lomita, so the car can be moved for the 22nd Street parking lot project.
